description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a freelance position based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 1 day of remote work per week.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You’ll Do

1. Design & Build AI Systems

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.
  • Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.
  • Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.
  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack

  • Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.
  • Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.
  • Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.
  • Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact

  • Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.
  • Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.
  • Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.
  • Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.
  • Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.
  • Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.
  • Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement

  • Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.
  • Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.
  • Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.
  • Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL

  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems
  • Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products
  • Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact
  • Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and business impact
  • Performance and reliability of AI systems
  • Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1h30 technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French.

description: Your mission Build the backbone of intelligent energy systems. You'll develop backend systems that turn complex optimization algorithms into reliable, real-time decisions for industrial energy systems. From the core APIs of our optimization platform to integrations with energy management systems, you make sure our platform runs fast, stable and reliable. Your work lets our customers intelligently control and optimize battery storage, photovoltaic systems, charging infrastructure and other energy assets. This isn't a job building standard CRUD applications. You'll work on the technological core of our product, where architecture decisions directly shape performance, scalability and the success of our solution. Develop backend systems You'll design, build and improve the central services of our optimization platform. You'll work on core APIs, orchestration logic and the interfaces between our systems, always aiming for robust, high-performing and maintainable solutions. Own APIs and integrations You'll integrate external energy management systems (EMS), partner solutions and customer systems. You'll build clean, well-documented APIs and handle the problems that come up in real-world use, such as incomplete data, retry mechanisms and outages of individual systems. Help shape infrastructure and operations You take responsibility for keeping our services reliable in production. From CI/CD and our cloud infrastructure (Heroku / AWS) to monitoring, alerting and performance tuning, you keep everything running smoothly. Make systems scalable You design systems from the start to grow with our customers. You spot bottlenecks early, improve observability, and keep our platform stable and fast as complexity grows. Deliver features end to end You'll work in a small, cross-functional team with a strong on-site focus. You'll own features through the whole development process, from the first idea through design and implementation to deployment and monitoring. Raise the technical bar You bring your experience to the table and set high technical standards. You help shape architecture decisions, share knowledge with the team, and help backend engineering at EnopAI keep getting better. Your profile At least 7 years of experience building and running production backend systems. Excellent Python skills and solid experience with FastAPI, asyncio, relational databases and frameworks such as SQLAlchemy. AI-first mindset: you use AI and AI agents as a normal part of your daily development work to speed up boilerplate, tests and refactoring, so you have more time for architecture, product and hard technical problems. Cloud and DevOps experience: you're confident working in cloud environments and familiar with CI/CD, infrastructure as code and running modern backend systems. A strong sense for architecture. You build solutions that work reliably today and still scale tomorrow, and you know when pragmatism matters more than perfection. Founder mindset: you take ownership, think like an entrepreneur and make technical decisions proactively instead of just implementing requirements. You enjoy working with strong engineers, give constructive feedback and hold your own work and the team's to a high standard. You value the pace of a small team and like working on-site in Munich, because fast decisions and close collaboration make a real difference to you. You speak fluent, business-level German and English. Nice to have Experience with InfluxDB or other time-series databases. Interest in energy systems, optimization algorithms or mathematical models. Why us? The pace of an ambitious startup where your ideas count and you have real influence on product and technology. A competitive salary plus extra benefits such as the EGYM Wellpass. The chance to make a concrete contribution to the energy transition through your work. A central office right at Goetheplatz in Munich, with the option to work from home by arrangement. An environment where you keep growing: together with a strong engineering team, you'll build innovative software, solve challenging technical problems and help shape the future of intelligent energy systems. description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Front Office Transformation practice are looking for experienced consultants to join the team. 

Our Digital & Technology team are hiring highly motivated and talented individuals to help our clients shape and delivery their Front Office Transformation using platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Dynamics and Braze. Our team are passionate about helping clients define and realise the outcomes that will transform their business from a strategy, proposition, procurement, commercial, cultural and organisational perspective.  

What you will be doing

You will be joining our small but perfectly formed practice who are passionate about how platform technology can accelerate our clients modernisation and transformation agenda. You will be involved in helping clients understand what makes their customers tick by: 

  • Shape Front Office transformation strategies by helping clients understand customer, colleague and stakeholder needs, defining growth ambitions and translating these into customer, CRM, AI, sales, service and marketing strategies enabled by Salesforce, ServiceNow and adjacent technologies. 
  • Design future customer and colleague experiences by facilitating executive and cross-functional co-creation, developing customer journeys, service propositions, operating models and transformation roadmaps that create measurable business value. 
  • Define and mobilise transformation programmes by shaping governance, delivery approaches, business cases and procurement activities, helping clients select and maximise the value of Salesforce, ServiceNow and wider front office technologies. 
  • Lead complex business and technology transformations by bringing together multidisciplinary teams across customer experience, CRM, service operations, AI, data, architecture and ecosystem partners to successfully deliver strategic outcomes. 
  • Unlock the value of customer data, AI and automation by helping organisations harness platforms such as Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce and ServiceNow to create more intelligent, personalised and efficient customer and employee experiences. 
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing leadership across strategy, product ownership and transformation delivery and roadmaps while ensuring customer, colleague and commercial outcomes remain at the centre of decision-making. 
  • Contribute to the growth of Baringa's Front Office Transformation practice through thought leadership, proposition development, alliance management, recruitment and capability building across Salesforce, ServiceNow and emerging front office technologies. 

 
Your skills and experience  

  • You will bring a diverse mix of Front Office understanding including design, implementation and functional expertise of one or more platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow or Braze. 
  • Deep experience in relevant design across business, technology and data capabilities. 
  • Functional leads who have a deep understanding of how Salesforce can underpin the modernisation of a client’s business as part their Front Office & Digital Transformation agenda. 
  • Demonstrating curiosity and creativity in how platform technologies and AI can accelerate and bring value to our clients.  

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril is the world's fastest-growing defence technology company, bringing commercial technology talent and venture funding to the defence and security sectors. Our technology helps Australia, the United States, and allied nations solve their hardest national security challenges by enabling operators to make better, more informed decisions in life-and-death situations. We have assembled a diverse team of experts in artificial intelligence, computer vision, sensor fusion, optics, and data analysis that are creating software and hardware solutions to radically evolve the capabilities of Australia, the United States, our allies, and commercial customers. If you are passionate about solving problems that have a real impact, come join Anduril and build the future of defence.

A critical part of the Anduril team is its Contracts Managers, who play a crucial role in program success. They interface daily with a motivated team of program leadership, functional leadership, and customers in fast-paced environments.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is seeking a talented Contracts Manager to support a variety of Government, International, and Commercial contracts and programs. In this role, you will oversee the full contract lifecycle for Anduril's government and commercial contracts, ensuring compliance, minimizing risk, and optimizing contract performance. The ideal candidate will combine deep knowledge of commercial and defence contracting with strong negotiation skills and a passion for supporting national security through technological innovation.

The position will be responsible for providing contract support for various Government contracts and commercial contracts. Support of these contracts will involve proposal support, contract negotiation, contract compliance, contract management, contract modifications, and contract close-out. This role works closely with the legal and proposal teams as well as across the spectrum of Anduril’s accounting, business operations, program, and engineering teams.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Execute contract management throughout the life of each contract.
  • Complete contract review and acceptance.
  • Oversee and prepare contract proposal planning and management and support preparation of proposals.
  • Ensure compliance with government regulations, legal requirements, and company policies.
  • Assist in identification, development, and implementation of new contract policies and processes.
  • Maintain comprehensive contract documentation and compliance records.
  • Provide contract summaries and ensure contract execution in accordance with government and company requirements.
  • Provide program managers and executives with contract briefs during the life of contracts.
  • Provide guidance on ASDEFCON requirements and other regulatory considerations.
  • Cultivate strong, ongoing relationships with internal/external customers.
  • Provide contractual guidance and risk mitigation strategies for contractual and business obligations.
  • Negotiate complex contractual terms with government agencies, prime contractors, and subcontractors.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 6+ years of relevant contract management experience.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in business administration, government, or a related field.
  • A strong working knowledge of Australian Government contracting including ASDEFCON, Commonwealth Procurement Rules (CPRs), and/or Defence Security Principles Framework (DSPF) experience.
  • Experience with full life cycle contract management for various types of contract agreements
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities. You are highly respected amongst your peers and/or counterparts and known as someone who gets things done.
  • Australian citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain an NV1 security clearance.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Direct experience working for or with major Australian defence primes
  • IACCM/World Commerce & Contracting certification, Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM), or similar professional credentials
  • Graduate degree in business, law, government, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of AUKUS initiatives and Australia-US-UK defence collaboration framework

Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:

    • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is ----- before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

    • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to 

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. description:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Performance Engineer who is passionate about getting the most out of embedded systems — from low-level Linux tuning and hardware integration to high-performance video and data pipelines. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to hardware, moving across the stack, and solving the kinds of problems where milliseconds, bandwidth, startup time, and system efficiency matter.

You will work across the AuterionOS ecosystem on topics such as:

  • Embedded Linux performance and system tuning
  • Low-latency video streaming and media pipelines
  • C/C++, Python, and Bash-based platform development
  • Hardware integration, system profiling, and end-to-end optimization
  • Collaboration with experienced and driven engineers across Auterion

Responsibilities

  • Work within the Apps & Simulation team and collaborate with other development teams to build high-performance products for autonomous systems.
  • Design, optimize, and maintain performance-critical components within AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.
  • Improve end-to-end system behavior across compute, networking, video, and hardware interfaces, with a strong focus on latency, throughput, reliability, and resource efficiency.
  • Analyze and optimize demanding workloads such as real-time telemetry, video streaming, media processing, and communication between distributed system components.
  • Investigate system bottlenecks across the full stack, from kernel and OS behavior to application-level code and tooling.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases, and translate them into robust technical solutions.
  • Propose and implement new platform capabilities with a strong emphasis on measurable performance gains in real-world deployments.
  • Participate in daily stand-ups, release planning, and prioritization discussions.

Qualifications and Skills

  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience writing object-oriented C++ and/or Python.
  • Deep experience with embedded Linux systems, including cross-compilation, debugging, profiling, and performance tuning.
  • Strong hands-on background in diagnosing and optimizing real-world system behavior, including CPU, memory, I/O, networking, boot time, and application latency.
  • Experience building or optimizing low-latency video or data-streaming pipelines, ideally on embedded platforms.
  • Excellent understanding of software systems that span embedded devices, higher-level applications, and fully integrated products.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, implementation, debugging, and testing.
  • Experience with video codecs, GStreamer, RTP/RTSP, or hardware-accelerated media pipelines.
  • Solid experience with Debian/Ubuntu-based systems, Bash scripting, and systemd.
  • Experience with Docker and docker-compose in complex development and deployment environments, as well as qemu.
  • Strong debugging and performance analysis skills at both system and application level, combined with a proactive and self-directed working style.
  • Proficient in ROS2/DDS-style middleware and experienced with networking across multiple OSI layers, including REST APIs and performance-sensitive communication paths.
  • Experience with system integration and interfacing sensors or peripherals, especially via USB and Ethernet.
  • Experience working in an agile engineering environment with stand-ups, sprint planning, and shared ownership across teams.
  • Bonus: Experience with build systems such as CMake, including improving build performance in large-scale software projects.

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Company pension plan 
  • Car parking  
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Mental health and wellbeing support
  • Learning and development opportunities

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

You will build and operate the shared foundations that every AI feature team relies on: deploying, tuning, and scaling open-weight models across our GPU fleet, contributing directly to faster, safer, and more cost-efficient AI for care teams and patients across Europe.
Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Build the shared LLM serving foundations with MLOps engineers — define the serving stack, GPU capacity planning, and deployment automation for open-weight models (Gemma, Mistral, Llama, Qwen, and their fine-tuned variants) on Ray Serve / Anyscale, while shaping the evolution toward Kubernetes-based orchestration
  • Own the model registry and promotion path — establish clear processes for versioning, validating, and promoting models into production, benchmark performance and output quality under realistic workloads, and maintain the curated model catalog together with the Agents Platform team
  • Optimize inference performance and efficiency — operate and tune serving engines (vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT-LLM) to reduce time-to-first-token, inter-token latency, and cost per token through batching, caching, quantization, and parallelism strategies across our GPU fleet (L4 to H200)
  • Own production reliability and disaster recovery — define SLOs, run load tests before launches, implement safe rollouts, rollbacks, and autoscaling, and participate in on-call and incident response
  • Make serving performance and costs measurable — build Datadog dashboards, alerting, and cost reporting to track latency, GPU utilization, and inference spend, and identify opportunities to improve resource efficiency
  • Keep the inference stack secure, compliant, and evolving — work with Security and Privacy on network isolation, data residency, and auditability, while continuously assessing new models, serving engines (such as SGLang), and GPU generations

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.
You'll be a great fit if you:
  • Have 5+ years of software or computer engineering experience, including hands-on production experience with at least one LLM serving engine (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, TGI, or Triton) — ideally having chosen, introduced, tuned, or scaled one in production, not just run it with defaults
  • Are proficient in Python and Terraform, with a solid understanding of transformer inference mechanics: prefill vs. decode, KV cache, batching strategies, and why a model is compute- or memory-bound on a given GPU
  • Have strong experience running GPU workloads on Kubernetes or a managed Ray / Anyscale platform, and a performance engineering mindset — you design reproducible benchmarks, read profiler output, and back decisions with numbers
  • Are comfortable owning production reliability: observability, incident response, and on-call are a natural part of the role
  • Have excellent communication and collaboration skills, high agency, a pragmatic build-vs-buy approach, and are comfortable working in a scope that is still taking shape
  • Are fluent in English
It would be fantastic if you:
  • Have experience with distributed serving frameworks (KServe, llm-d, NVIDIA Dynamo), including disaggregated prefill/decode or KV-cache-aware routing, or with serving Mixture-of-Experts, multimodal models, or many LoRA adapters on shared base models
  • Have GPU kernel experience or deep profiling skills (CUDA, Triton, Nsight), or have contributed to open-source inference projects
  • Have experience in regulated environments (healthcare, finance, public sector) and with frameworks such as GDPR, HDS, ISO 27001, or SOC 2

Our stack

  • Programming languages: Python, plus comfort reading/debugging a systems language (C++, Rust, or Go)
  • Cloud providers: GCP / AWS / Azure
  • Serving orchestration: Ray Serve / Anyscale (GCP), with Kubernetes (GKE) + GPU scheduling as an emerging parallel target
  • LLM serving engines (in production): vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT-LLM (also evaluating SGLang and other emerging engines)
  • Models: Self-hosted open-weight LLMs (Gemma, Mistral, Llama, Qwen), fine-tuned in-house
  • Experiment tracking & model registry: MLflow
  • GenAI gateway: LiteLLM
  • LLM evaluation & observability: Braintrust
  • GPUs: NVIDIA L4, A10G, L40S, RTX 6000 Pro, A100 (40GB/80GB), H200
  • Container / Infra as code: Docker, Terraform, Helm, Kustomize

  • And any other tool you deem relevant!

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our ADAS Team Wayve's ADAS engineering teams build the perception and intelligence that power driver assistance in real-world driving. We work end-to-end, from creating high-quality training data, to developing and evaluating CV/3D perception models, to iterating quickly based on performance gaps. The team mixes "online" (on-car, latency/compute constrained) and "offline" (heavier, large-scale data generation) work, with a strong focus on measurable impact and shipping. 🧠 Your day-to-day Train, debug, and improve computer vision and 3D perception models, iterating based on clear evaluation signals Work across the full ML lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, and iteration Partner with the team to decide what to tackle next, based on where the system is underperforming Build scalable data pipelines, including auto-labelling and pseudo-labelling, to accelerate model development 🧩 What you'll be working on: Core ADAS perception capabilities such as detection, classification, and instance segmentation, spanning lanes, objects, traffic signs, and traffic lights End-to-end approaches that let the model act on the world directly, rather than relying on a chain of hand-coded intermediate steps (lane assist without ever explicitly detecting lane lines is the kind of outcome we're after) Online perception that runs fast in-car as part of our production stack Offline perception work using additional inputs not viable for on-road production, including extra sensors like lidar, future frames, maps, and extra compute, to improve data quality and coverage at scale Building the "data flywheel": using offline models and 3D tracking/reconstruction to auto-generate labels and accelerate iteration across perception tasks 👤 You should apply if: Built and shipped CV-focused deep learning systems, with strong applied ML engineering rather than research-only work Experience with 3D perception concepts or pipelines, such as LiDAR, multi-view geometry, tracking, or 3D reconstruction Comfortable owning work end-to-end, including evaluation and large-scale dataset generation Enjoy pragmatic problem-solving under real product constraints Excited to improve real-world driving performance through better perception Automotive domain experience is a bonus, but not a blocker if your perception background comes from elsewhere 🌱 Not ticking every box? That's totally okay! If you're passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚗 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve's mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻 — Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 📋 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) Competency interviews (programming and system design; 2 hours) Deep-dive technical interviews (Hiring manager/Domain Interview; 1 hour) Final interview: mission & values alignment (1 hour) We'll always explain the format and work around your availability. What's in it for you (Location dependent): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partner discounts and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law. For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory. description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. About the team The Credit Risk team is part of Airwallex’s Second Line of Defence and helps the company grow responsibly as a global financial platform. We work at the intersection of credit, FX, and counterparty risk, partnering closely with Product, Sales, Operations, Treasury, Finance, Engineering, Compliance, and Legal to enable commercial growth while protecting Airwallex from financial loss and excessive risk exposure. This is a team for analytical, commercially minded risk leaders who are energized by building scalable frameworks and practical controls across a fast-moving, multi-currency global network. What you'll do As a Senior Manager, Credit Risk, you will lead Airwallex's global second-line oversight of credit, FX, and counterparty risk. You will set the risk guardrails that allow the business to grow safely across merchant acquiring, charge cards, FX, treasury, settlement, and banking-partner activities. Reporting to the Senior Director, Financial Risk, you will own the global framework, risk appetite, limits, governance, and portfolio oversight for these risk areas. You will provide independent challenge to first-line decisions and act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders across the business. This role is based in London. Responsibilities Credit risk framework and risk appetite: Define, implement, and continuously enhance the global second-line credit risk framework, including policies, risk appetite thresholds, limits, escalation protocols, and governance standards across Airwallex’s products and legal entities. Credit portfolio oversight: Oversee credit exposures across merchant acquiring, charge cards, B2B and commercial activities, FX pre-funding, treasury-related exposures, settlement flows, and other relevant products. Underwriting and limit governance: Review and challenge first-line underwriting strategies, customer and merchant risk policies, credit assessments, limit-setting methodologies, and exception processes. Act as a senior escalation point for complex or high-value credit decisions. FX risk oversight: Establish and monitor appropriate second-line guardrails for FX exposures arising from pre-funding, settlement, customer activity, treasury flows, and other multi-currency activities. Challenge controls, limits, escalation triggers, and risk reporting to ensure exposures remain within approved tolerances. Counterparty risk management: Set and oversee counterparty risk standards for banking partners, payment partners, merchants, customers, and other material counterparties. Establish appropriate exposure limits, concentration thresholds, monitoring requirements, and escalation processes. Portfolio monitoring and early warning indicators: Lead proactive monitoring of credit, FX, and counterparty portfolios, including exposure, concentration, delinquency, default, chargeback, loss, settlement, liquidity-of-counterparty, and other relevant risk indicators. Identify emerging trends and escalate material issues before they become systemic. Loss mitigation and remediation: Review and challenge first-line monitoring, collections, collateral, prefunding, reserves, chargeback, and other mitigation strategies. Ensure deteriorating counterparties, customers, merchants, or exposures are identified and addressed promptly. New products and market expansion: Partner with Product, Engineering, Commercial, Treasury, Finance, and Operations to assess and challenge the risk design of new products, features, markets, currencies, and partner arrangements before launch. Risk approvals and governance: Lead or support risk committee decisions, material risk approvals, limit exceptions, breach assessments, and remediation plans. Ensure decisions are documented clearly and aligned with approved risk appetite. Regulatory and partner engagement: Represent Credit Risk during regulatory examinations, internal and external audits, and reviews with banking and strategic partners. Prepare clear, decision-useful materials for senior management, risk committees, and the Board where appropriate. Who you are We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory. Minimum qualifications 10–15 years of progressively senior experience across credit risk, counterparty risk, FX risk, treasury risk, or related financial risk disciplines within banking, payments, fintech, or another highly regulated financial services environment. Deep experience designing, implementing, and governing second-line credit risk frameworks in a complex, multi-jurisdictional organization. Strong understanding of credit risk identification, measurement, underwriting, limit management, monitoring, mitigation, provisioning, loss recognition, and capital implications. Demonstrated experience managing risk across multiple product lines, such as merchant acquiring, commercial or charge cards, B2B lending, payment processing, FX, treasury, settlement, or banking-partner activities. Practical experience overseeing FX and counterparty risk, including exposure measurement, concentration risk, limits, settlement risk, prefunding, collateral or other mitigants, and escalation governance. Proven ability to challenge first-line decisions and communicate clear risk positions to senior executives, commercial leaders, product and operations teams, banking partners, auditors, and regulators. Preferred qualifications Advanced degree such as an MBA or Master's in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or a related field. Professional certification such as FRM, PRM, CFA, or an equivalent qualification. Experience with automated decisioning engines, credit scoring models, portfolio analytics, or alternative data used in underwriting and monitoring. Familiarity with IFRS 9, expected credit loss methodologies, stress testing, or other relevant prudential and accounting frameworks. Strong data literacy and familiarity with SQL, Python, or similar tools used to analyze portfolio, exposure, and loss trends. Experience working in a regulated payments fintech, digital bank, or financial institution with multiple licenses and banking partnerships. Comfort operating in a high-growth environment with evolving priorities and a bias for practical, scalable execution. Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. Equal opportunity Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact 
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your mission

As Senior Manager – Data Engineering & Machine Learning, you’ll lead Catawiki’s established team of Data Engineers and Machine Learning specialists. You’ll help the team grow, set its technical direction and build on work already underway across data foundations and production machine learning.

The role spans two connected disciplines. You’ll bring deep experience in either Data Engineering or Machine Learning Engineering, and enough breadth to set direction across the other.

You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business stakeholders to set priorities and connect the team’s work to outcomes across Catawiki.

What you'll do

You’ll lead the team through platform modernisation and product-facing ML work. Current priorities include modernising the infrastructure for serving production models, introducing a feature store to improve feature management and consistency across model training and serving, and strengthening observability and cost controls. You’ll help set priorities and raise the reliability and impact of this work.

  • Lead and develop the team: Set direction, coach experienced specialists and create clear ownership across Data Engineering and Machine Learning.
  • Build dependable data foundations: Improve the pipelines, integrations and infrastructure the wider Data team relies on for analysis, reporting and machine learning.
  • Strengthen production ML: Improve deployment, monitoring and operational follow-through for production models, so teams can run them reliably and resolve issues effectively.
  • Advance marketplace models: Help teams improve recommendation, cancellation and bidder-risk use cases, connecting model performance to meaningful product outcomes.
  • Set direction and priorities: Work with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business partners to choose high-value problems and balance delivery, reliability and long-term platform health.
  • Shape the technology strategy: Reporting to the SVP Engineering, you’ll join the Engineering Management team and help shape the direction of the Technology department.

What you'll bring

You combine strong technical judgement with experienced people leadership. You create clarity in a complex environment, empower specialists and make sound decisions across both disciplines.

Your experience will include the following. Familiarity with Catawiki’s current stack is useful, and equivalent experience with other platforms is welcome.

  • Technical depth in one discipline: Deep experience designing, building and operating data-intensive systems in Data Engineering or Machine Learning Engineering, with practical knowledge of the other.
  • People leadership: Experience leading experienced engineers or ML specialists, coaching their growth and setting clear expectations.
  • Architecture and systems thinking: Ability to evaluate trade-offs and guide architecture for data platforms, distributed systems and production infrastructure.
  • Production ML understanding: Experience with the deployment, monitoring and operation of machine learning systems in production.
  • Business and product judgement: Ability to connect technical work to business goals, make priority calls and assess outcomes.
  • Relevant cloud platform experience: We run on GCP using BigQuery, Vertex AI and Kubernetes. Experience with equivalent AWS services is also relevant.
  • Streaming and integration experience: Kafka, event-driven systems or modern data integration tools are useful.
  • Clear communication: Ability to explain technical trade-offs and align technical and non-technical stakeholders.

How we work

  • You’ll lead a team of eight Data Engineers and Machine Learning specialists across Amsterdam and Lisbon.
  • The team works closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business stakeholders to connect data and ML capabilities to real needs.
  • Specialists own implementation while you set direction, priorities and clear standards.
  • The team supports production data and ML systems, and has no on-call rotation.

Where you'll be

This is a hybrid role in Amsterdam. You will work from our Amsterdam HQ a minimum of 2 days per week.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

  • Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
  • Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
  • A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
  • Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested?

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the review of your application. AI may help us assess how your experience matches the requirements of the role, but hiring decisions are always made by our recruitment team

description:
Mavericks Wanted 

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on 
 
In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.  
 
Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work. 

What You’ll Do

You will report to the Director, Medical Excellence & Operations, International, and work closely with International Medical Affairs, Field Medical, Clinical Development, Commercial, Legal and Regulatory colleagues to strengthen medical excellence across BridgeBio. Your primary purpose will be to lead medical excellence initiatives across the Medical Affairs organization, such as scientific communications, field medical, training and other medical excellence priorities as the business evolves. This role requires effective collaboration with Medical Directors, cross-functional colleagues and external experts to ensure scientifically rigorous, consistent and compliant communications and practices. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in scientific/medical communications with strong project management experience and stakeholder management skills, and thrives on delivering priorities in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.

Responsibilities

  • Support the development of scientific communication plans from an international perspective (i.e., core scientific narratives, key messages and Q&A documents), in close collaboration with Medical Directors and cross-functional brand teams
  • Develop high-quality scientific and medical education content for congresses, symposia, advisory boards, internal training and other settings, ensuring alignment with the medical strategy
  • Partner with Legal, Regulatory and Medical reviewers to ensure all scientific and medical communications are accurate, balanced and compliant, in line with the Medical, Legal and Regulatory (MLR) review process
  • Support the design and delivery of onboarding, training and continuous learning programs for Medical Affairs, including building scientific and therapeutic area capability across the organization

description: Senior People Partner Cloudscaler | London | People Team | Reports to the Chief People Officer | £55,000–£75,000 Someone has to own the People initiative that doesn’t fit neatly into anyone’s week and the case nobody else should be handling. That someone is you — not as an escalation point, but as the person who runs the day-to-day of this function. THE MOMENT Cloudscaler is 130 people today. We’ll be 170 by the end of this year, and roughly double again in 2027. The People function is being built in real time alongside that growth, rather than inherited from someone who left years ago. You’ll be the first hire into the People team. For roughly your first year you’ll be the only People professional alongside the CPO, which means running the whole day-to-day of the function: the hardest casework and initiatives, and the operational core that keeps everything moving. A People Partner is planned to join later in 2027, and at that point the operational administration moves to them. This is also a role built with room to grow. As the team expands beyond that second hire, we expect this role to take on day-to-day operational leadership of the People Partner practice, but that isn’t the shape of it on day one. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT In most People teams, the senior generalist is just a People Partner with a harder case queue. Here, the difference is ownership, not just difficulty. Complex casework: Rather than simply handling harder cases, you’ll own the most complex cases end to end, with no hand back. People initiatives: Rather than contributing to initiatives someone else drives, you’ll own them from design through to embedding. Decision-making: Rather than escalating ambiguity upward, you’ll make the sensible call and document your reasoning. CPO partnership: Rather than acting in a support role to the CPO, you’ll be an operational partner they can confidently delegate to. To be clear about the level: The CPO still designs the People strategy and the systems architecture. You own how it runs day to day, and you’re trusted to run a whole initiative, not just a case. That is a different job to People Partner, not a bigger version of the same one. THE ROLE You’ll sit in the People team reporting to the Chief People Officer. Three strands make up the job: Casework: The employee relations situations with the most complexity or sensitivity land with you, start to finish. Initiatives: When the CPO needs a piece of work owned (a policy rollout, a wellbeing programme, a piece of the reward or benefits agenda), you take it from design through to something that runs. Operations: Until the People Partner joins, you’ll own payroll and benefits administration, onboarding, screening and security clearances, and keeping Rippling accurate. When the People Partner joins, they’ll report to the CPO. You won’t manage them formally, but you’ll lead their handover, you’ll be the person they come to first, and your judgement will set the standard for how this function operates day to day. WHERE THE ROLE STARTS AND STOPS New roles get vague, so here is the boundary as we see it today. Yours The most complex and sensitive employee relations casework, end to end. Full ownership of People initiatives, from design to embedding. Acting as the CPO’s operational partner on ambiguous or cross-cutting problems. Until the People Partner joins (planned for later in 2027): Payroll and benefits administration, including the monthly payroll cycle in Rippling and Mintago. Pre-onboarding, onboarding and probation. Background screening in Zinc. Security clearance coordination. Rippling data quality, workflows and reporting. Our working groups and committees. Once the People Partner joins: A structured handover of the operational core. Day-to-day guidance for the People Partner. Shared Ashby, which Talent Acquisition owns. You’ll work in it from offer through to start date on every hire until the People Partner joins, and on senior hires after that. Mentoring and supporting the People Partner on their casework and initiatives, once they join. Not yours Recruitment delivery, which sits with Talent Acquisition. The design of the People strategy, the operating model and the systems architecture, which sit with the CPO. Formal line management of the People Partner, who will report to the CPO. THE STACK Rippling: Our single source of truth. Until the People Partner joins you’ll run it day to day, including the monthly payroll cycle, data quality and workflows, and you’ll use its reporting at a level that supports whole initiatives. Zinc: Background screening. You’ll run checks for every new joiner until the People Partner joins, and stay close to the senior and sensitive hires after that. Ashby: Owned by Talent Acquisition. You’ll work in it from offer through to start date on the hires you’re responsible for. Claude: A daily tool here. You’ll use it for casework preparation, drafting policy and communications, and pulling together the analysis behind an initiative. Mintago: Our employee benefits and financial wellbeing platform (pensions, salary sacrifice and financial advice). You’ll administer it and keep enrolment accurate until the People Partner takes it on. WHAT YOU’LL DO Own the hardest casework. You’ll run our most complex and sensitive employee relations cases end to end, with the CPO there to sense-check rather than take over. Own initiatives, not tasks. You’ll take a People initiative from a rough brief to something that’s running and embedded, rather than handing it back once the interesting part is done. Run the operational core. Until the People Partner joins, you’ll own the monthly payroll cycle in Rippling, benefits administration including Mintago, onboarding, background screening and security clearances. Accurate, on time, and documented as you go. Hand it over well. When the People Partner arrives, you’ll give them a working system and a clear handover, then stay the person they come to first and the judgement others in the function measure themselves against. Partner with senior leaders. You’ll be credible with leaders on the most difficult conversations: complex change, capability, and situations without a clean playbook. Use AI properly. You’ll use Claude daily to take time out of your own week, checking anything that touches a decision about a person and owning the outcome. Improve what you find. You’ll spot the gaps in policy, process or practice before anyone else does, and bring the CPO a considered view on the fix, not just the problem. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AT 12 MONTHS You’re running the most complex ER cases with confidence, and the CPO isn’t being pulled into them. At least one or two People initiatives have gone from a rough brief to something genuinely embedded, owned by you. Payroll, benefits, onboarding and clearances run accurately and on time, and every process is documented well enough to hand over. You’ve helped shape the People Partner hire, so the handover is ready when they land. Senior leaders treat you as a credible operational partner, not an escalation point. You’ve made and documented sensible calls in genuinely ambiguous situations, and they’ve held up. The CPO can hand you an ambiguous problem and trust it gets shaped properly. WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR Deep employee relations experience. You’ve run complex disciplinaries, grievances and change situations yourself, and you know exactly when to escalate and when not to. CIPD qualification, or solid progress towards it, is welcome. A track record of owning initiatives. You can point to work you took from a brief to something that actually ran, not just a project you contributed to. Hands-on with the operational detail. You’ve owned or closely supported a payroll cycle, benefits administration and onboarding, and you’re comfortable being accountable for their accuracy while also carrying the senior work. Credible with senior leaders. You can hold your own in a difficult conversation with someone under real pressure and be listened to. Comfortable operating near-autonomously. You don’t need a playbook for everything. You make a sensible call, write it down, and check it with the CPO afterwards. Ready to grow into people leadership. You won’t formally manage anyone at the start, but you’ll induct and guide the People Partner when they join, and you should want to lead a team as the structure catches up. Discreet and organised at volume. Complex casework and live initiatives, often at the same time. You’ll need a system, and it can’t be your memory. THE HONEST PART This role sits in an odd space for now: senior in scope and judgement, without a team underneath it yet. Until the People Partner joins later in 2027, you’ll also be the whole operational team, so a payroll deadline and a complex grievance can land in the same week. That eases as the function grows, but it means the authority you carry day to day has to come from the quality of your work, not a job title. You are not designing the People strategy or the systems architecture. The CPO does that. What you get instead is real ownership of the hardest cases and the initiatives that matter, a close working relationship with the CPO, and a genuine path toward leading the People Partner practice as it grows. This probably isn’t for you if you want a formal team from day one, or if you’d rather leave payroll and onboarding to someone else. It probably is for you if you want to prove you can run this function well enough, top to bottom, that a team gets built around you. If that sounds like the challenge you’ve been looking for, let’s talk. description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times is continuing to expand its video journalism, identifying compelling visual stories across the depth and breadth of our reporting. We showcase the expertise of Times journalists on camera, share urgent news updates, produce on-the-ground reporting, and pioneer Visual Investigations.

The Video department is looking for a Senior Producer to work on the multi-disciplinary Reporter Video team of video journalists who create powerful videos featuring the expertise of our world-class journalists. Based in London, this role will focus on covering breaking news and major international developments in short-form video, producing a mix of quick-turnaround videos, explanatory and analysis pieces, as well as major enterprise and investigations. 

The Senior Producer will report to a London supervisor and work with the rest of the Reporter Video team in New York and other video hubs, becoming the key manager of the department’s content during the hours that London acts as the main Times hub. 

We are looking for a strong leader who is eager to motivate, inspire teams and innovate. Attention to detail, impeccable organization and effective communication with reporters and editors in the International Desk are a must.

You should also be an excellent storyteller with an eye for visual short-form digital formats, able to work autonomously to identify critical stories outside the U.S. and make sound, quick editorial decisions on world news. You will be expected to produce engaging stories through original reporting, on-the-ground filming, motion graphics and studio-based recordings.

You must have deep experience reporting on stories from Europe, the Middle East and Africa, including managing teams in conflict zones, devising security plans and making risk assessments.

This is a hybrid position based in London and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Drive innovative Reporter Video delivering on a range of formats.

  • Build and strengthen relations with colleagues on the International Desk, including mentorship of reporters, photographers and fellow editors on the reporter video storytelling format.

  • Lead story development and story edits.

  • Review, assign and provide feedback on productions.

  • Support and guide script writing and visual approaches for effective short-form video.

  • Oversee production across multiple projects.
